selection.ownership: ClickHouse, Inc., United States. Open-source analytics database with ClickHouse Cloud and self-hosted HTTP. International product; Yandex origin does not make this a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official ClickHouse HTTP interface (HTTP Basic username:password, POST SQL with default_format=JSON, caller-supplied host such as https://host:8443 or http://localhost:8123), ClickHouse Cloud multi-label hosts, ClickHouse Inc. US identity, DeepSeek January 2025 customer-misconfigured open ClickHouse, patched product CVEs, and dated incident search (ClickHouse + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Pinned source requires an arbitrary public HTTP(S) baseUrl and may allow private-network access. No Algolia-style required stored id plus bounded wildcard covers official Cloud regional hosts and self-hosted instances. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official ClickHouse HTTP uses caller-supplied hosts and HTTP Basic. Pinned OpenConnector accepts any public HTTP(S) baseUrl. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found DeepSeek's January 2025 open ClickHouse as a customer misconfiguration, plus patched product CVEs, not a ClickHouse Cloud platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.affectedData: DeepSeek's ClickHouse was reachable on the public internet with a default user and no password; this was a customer misconfiguration of open-source ClickHouse, not a ClickHouse Cloud control-plane breach.
incidents.status: historical customer misconfiguration; ClickHouse subsequently restricted default-user network access in patched releases
incidents.remediation: ClickHouse patched default-user network access in 25.1.3.23 and backported LTS/stable releases. DeepSeek closed the exposure.
incidents.residualRisk: Self-hosted ClickHouse with default credentials remains an operator risk. Caller-supplied hosts are unsupported regardless of patch state.

remainingGates: boundedNetwork: pinned OpenConnector requires a caller-supplied ClickHouse HTTP baseUrl covering self-hosted instances and ClickHouse Cloud multi-label regional hosts. Native templates cannot admit arbitrary hosts. No Algolia-style required stored id plus a single bounded wildcard covers those official hosts.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Would validate ClickHouse credentials with SELECT currentDatabase() / version(). Host is not admitted.

request.body: SELECT currentDatabase() AS database, version() AS version

databases.list.title: List databases
databases.list.description: Would list ClickHouse databases from system.databases. Host is not admitted.

request.body: SELECT name, engine, toString(uuid) AS uuid FROM system.databases WHERE ({pattern:String} = '' OR name LIKE {pattern:String}) ORDER BY name

tables.list.title: List tables
tables.list.description: Would list ClickHouse tables from system.tables. Host is not admitted.

request.body: SELECT database, name, engine, is_temporary, total_rows, total_bytes, primary_key, sorting_key, partition_key FROM system.tables WHERE ({database:String} = '' OR database = {database:String}) AND ({pattern:String} = '' OR name LIKE {pattern:String}) AND is_temporary = 0 AND ({include_views:UInt8} = 1 OR engine NOT IN ('View', 'MaterializedView', 'LiveView', 'WindowView')) ORDER BY database, name
